decisions.reason: A reference electrometer close to the core dosimetry business and featured on the home page carries high investment and visible public commitment, so management will persist with it.

The oncology risk management software builds on the established offer and fits the announced direction of integration and prediction, so any slow uptake can still be blamed on temporary adoption cycles.
The CT phantom was only launched in 2024, extends the firm's imaging QA, and has its own page, so it is too early and too committed to abandon.
Although mammography is distant from the core, the recent launch and dedicated page signal commitment, and weak early results can be attributed to market entry effects.
It overlaps with Product D and is distant from the core, making it the likeliest to be consolidated, but the public commitment to the 2024 imaging expansion favors persisting.
The broad imaging QA instrument line represents the firm's announced strategic expansion and substantial investment, so it will be kept and justified.
